steps.title: Define App Specifications and Package Name
steps.description: Configure metadata inside app-meta.json for Notes Master app using unique package 'com.notesmaster.app'.

steps.title: Establish Gradle Settings Configuration
steps.description: Define root project settings in settings.gradle with central dependency repositories.

steps.title: Configure Root Build Gradle
steps.description: Set up top-level build script specifying the exact Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) version 8.3.2.

steps.title: Configure App-Level Build Gradle
steps.description: Set compiler configurations targeting SDK 34 and Java 1.8 compatibility options with no external dependencies.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest Layout
steps.description: Define launcher intents, permissions, and set default Material Light system theme without AndroidX namespaces.

steps.title: Create Note Entity Class
steps.description: Establish the standard POJO class Note to store identifiers, title, content, custom category, and timestamp values.

steps.title: Build SQLite Database Helper
steps.description: Develop DatabaseHelper to manage local tables, schema creations, pre-populating dummy starter notes and categories.

steps.title: Design App Main Layout Screen
steps.description: Build layout containing toolbar, quick Category creation triggers, Search edit field, Filter spinner, Empty state view, and FAB.

steps.title: Create Note Row Item Template
steps.description: Draft list row view to clearly display titles, categories, description snippets, date-times, and dynamic deletion action button.

steps.title: Design Dialog Layout for Note Form
steps.description: Implement customized popup inputs allowing user title text entry, multi-line content typing, and choosing dynamic categories.

steps.title: Design Dialog Layout for Custom Categories
steps.description: Implement compact input template allowing creation of custom unique categories.

steps.title: Implement Standard custom Adapter for Notes
steps.description: Create NoteAdapter extending BaseAdapter linking dataset records directly to layout UI component targets.

steps.title: Develop Main Logic and Event Handlers
steps.description: Implement Note filtering, real-time TextWatcher search, edit click triggers, delete confirmation logic, and dialog interactions in MainActivity.

steps.title: Verify Namespaces and Manifest Integrity
steps.description: Double check all xmlns declarations and verify that launcher activities match strict Java target frameworks.
